# Monocypher 4.0.2

Small, audited crypto library used for the end-to-end encrypted sync
(XChaCha20-Poly1305, Argon2i, X25519, BLAKE2b).

- Source: https://github.com/LoupVaillant/Monocypher (tag 4.0.2), files `src/monocypher.c` and `src/monocypher.h`, unchanged
- Licence: CC0-1.0 or BSD-2-Clause (see `LICENCE.md`), compatible with Qupil's GPL
